correctness.rationale: Thapper's even-length four-wide-cylinder matching tree establishes I(P_n×C4)≃ wedge^{n+1} S^{n−1}; Matsushita--Wakatsuki's suspension/Alexander-dual relation ΣD(L_n)^vee≃I(P_n×C4) and N=2n-vertex duality shift give D(L_n) one free H_{n−1} of rank n+1. For each group element the reduced signed Lefschetz sum is minus the weighted sum of invariant faces by number of included vertex orbits. Because n−1 is odd the homology trace is the latter sum. For layer swap the binary triple-avoidance transfer has exact four-state identity T_s^4 v=v and initial value −1 at n=2, yielding sign (−1)^{n/2}. For path reversal, left-half four-mask recurrence has sixteen states with (T_r²−I)²v=0, initial values (−1,3,−3,5), and yields (−1)^{n/2}(2⌊n/4⌋+1); reflected layer swap has the same trace by symmetry of endpoint/internal tests. Character orthogonality yields displayed irreducible multiplicities and rational quotient invariants. I independently enumerated all admissible dominance faces for n=2,4,6,8 and all four signed automorphism actions, obtaining vectors (3,−1,−1,−1),(5,1,3,3),(7,−1,−3,−3),(9,1,5,5), agreeing with exact all-n formulas. The source script contains exact T_s and T_r identities; independent mod-2 homology n=2,4,6 independently confirms degree/rank. A published ladder example has a degree-label discrepancy; the stated degree is confirmed by Alexander duality calculation and finite ranks.
